name: cdp5-agents
description: CDP5 agents for the engineering loop: judgment and counter-roles (konzept-reviewer, review-verify, adversarial-auditor, threat-modeler, mcp-security-reviewer, devils-advocate, pessimistic-realist, review-code, pm-retro), implementation workers (impl-debug, impl-uc, impl-refactor) and the orchestrate skill for the main session. Ships the shared worker contract (SubagentStart injection, SubagentStop acknowledgement and usage log) and a PreToolUse guard that keeps judgment agents read-only and workers off commit and push.
